assets.name: easel
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished standalone illustrated UI asset for Studioodle, a welcoming all-ages coloring and drawing studio. Subject: a charming wooden artist's easel holding a large inviting, mostly blank cream drawing pad. Actual transparent background, full object comfortably within frame, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, letters, labels or watermark.

Art direction: expressive hand-inked line art with elegant varied charcoal-blue contours, restrained warm watercolor/gouache washes and soft dimensional shading inside the object. A refined storybook illustration for adults and children, not a flat geometric icon and not a photorealistic render. Palette: ivory paper, warm honey wood, muted watery teal, a little peach/coral and soft gold. Clean readable silhouette at small UI sizes.

The PAPER is the hero: supple, gently bowed toward the viewer with an irregular natural edge and one upper sheet lifting in a graceful sweeping curl, turning over the top and falling behind the pad. Show paper flexibility and a clearly visible reverse surface of the turned sheet; no rigid top cap, no metal rings or spiral binding. A little air between the turning sheet and the front sheet. The substantial blank front sheet has only one beautiful teal paint swoosh, leaving most of the paper open for imagination. A coral-handled paintbrush rests diagonally near its edge, with a few tiny teal/gold magical ink sparkles suggesting you can create anything.

The easel has believable three-quarter perspective, two front legs and one receding rear leg, tactile wood grain, a shallow visible tray supporting the lower edge of the pad and a slim front lip. Paper sits ON the tray. Asymmetrical, lively, softly curved forms, fine confident lines; avoid stiff symmetry, thick blue backing panels, rectangular floating cards, cutesy faces, excessive decorative clutter. Single centered object filling about 85% of a square composition.

assets.name: coloring-book
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW standalone OPEN COLORING BOOK illustration for a premium all-ages drawing app. Actual transparent background, no ground shadow, no text or letters. Wide landscape composition, entire book visible. Expressive hand-inked charcoal-blue line work, delicate watercolor paper grain, warm ivory paper, restrained teal, coral and soft golden-yellow partial coloring. Charming botanical/fantasy coloring art: a large butterfly among flowers on the LEFT page, graceful wildflowers and leaves on the RIGHT. Most coloring shapes remain unpainted. Small coral fabric bookmark at the bottom and one coral pencil along the lower outside edge. Match a refined warm storybook illustration, not photorealism or flat geometric iconography.

CRITICAL BOOK GEOMETRY â€” prioritize this above decorative flourishes:
An almost ORTHOGRAPHIC OVERHEAD view of a real book opened nearly flat. Two facing portrait-format pages cut from identical sheets of paper. Each visible page has the SAME WIDTH and SAME HEIGHT, equal physical area and believable rectangular proportions. The spread is approximately 3:2 overall. The gutter runs almost STRAIGHT VERTICALLY down the exact center. Upper left and upper right corners reach the same horizontal level, and lower left and lower right corners reach the same horizontal level. Outer page edges are nearly parallel to each other and to the center gutter. Keep both page faces in one coherent near-flat perspective, without a strong oblique camera angle.
Do NOT taper or shrink the right page. Do NOT bow the pages into giant convex lens shapes. No fisheye, barrel distortion, kaleidoscope geometry, twisted gutter, mismatched page formats, pointed triangular page faces, extreme foreshortening or exaggerated converging edges. The page rectangles must read correctly even when the printed art is ignored.

Make it lively with subtle paper flex and ONE SMALL lifted upper-right corner confined to the outer 10% of that page, not an entire page lifted toward the viewer. Preserve gentle asymmetric construction through a thicker fan of about 10 page edges UNDER the left page and only 3â€“4 underneath the right. The DIFFERENCE IS PAGE COUNT, NOT PAGE FACE SIZE. Uneven small edge curls, slight offsets in underlying sheets and naturally different floral drawings give personality, while the two main page silhouettes stay balanced and evenly sized. A thin neutral cream cover only, no large colored backing, no rings, no extra props, no labels. Keep all silhouettes comfortably within frame and the outside completely transparent.
assets.originalPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone illustrated UI asset for Studioodle, a welcoming all-ages drawing and coloring studio. Subject: an inviting OPEN COLORING BOOK with distinctly asymmetrical curling pages, drawn as beautiful expressive hand-inked line art with restrained watercolor/gouache washes. Actual TRANSPARENT background, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, letters, logos, captions or watermark. Entire object comfortably in frame. Landscape-shaped book centered within a square composition, filling about 85% of the width.

Match a refined storybook art style: fine confident charcoal-blue outlines with natural variation, ivory paper texture, soft dimensional shading inside the object, watery muted teal, peach/coral and small golden accents. Not a stiff geometric icon, not a photorealistic photograph, not a glossy 3D toy, not overly childish. Readable as an open coloring book at a 180â€“300 pixel display size.

IMPORTANT ASYMMETRY: viewed from slightly above in a gentle three-quarter angle. It is opened well past its midpoint: a thick soft fan of MANY pages on the LEFT and only a FEW pages on the RIGHT, different page-block thicknesses, unequal visible page widths. The thinner right side lifts up with one corner curling gracefully, showing the reverse of a page. The left side lies lower and more open. A naturally curved gutter and bowed page surfaces; irregular hand-drawn flowing paper edges, no mirrored halves. No thick blue/green cover or solid colored backing panel; only thin cream paper layers and a discreet coral fabric bookmark.

The visible coloring artwork is charming flowing botanical/fantasy line art: a large butterfly among curling wildflowers and leaves, with small stars. Some petals, a butterfly wing and a few leaves have been painted softly in teal, warm coral and golden yellow; MOST of the interior shapes remain white, clearly inviting the user to color them. Both pages contain coherent, readable coloring art following the paper's curve. A coral coloring pencil rests loosely along the lower outside edge. A couple of tiny gold/teal sparkles, no excessive floating decorations. Convey discovery and creative possibility, with lively folds and believable book construction.
assets.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached open coloring book to add a gentle, believable BOW to its two facing pages. Preserve the same balanced equal-sized page format, butterfly on left, botanical flowers on right, hand-inked watercolor style, warm ivory paper, teal/coral/gold partial coloring, thick left stack and thinner right, pencil, bookmark, clean transparent background and full object composition. Both pages should have broad shallow convex curves, rising a little over the underlying page blocks and dipping smoothly into the central gutter. Show the curvature in gently arched top and bottom page edges, delicate dimensional shading near the gutter and slightly lifted outer edges. It should feel like a supple open book instead of a rigid flat rectangle. Keep this effect subtle and natural, no fisheye, distorted page widths, mismatched page heights, narrowing right page, extreme perspective or pointed sails. The two page faces must still read as equally sized sheets from one book, in a coherent near-overhead view. Keep tiny corner curls and a little variation between page bends, no mirrored perfection. Do not add props, text, ground shadow, or background. Outside actual book, pencil and bookmark silhouettes must stay fully transparent.

assets.name: paper-stack
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone decorative UI asset: a permanent BASE STACK OF LOOSE DRAWING PAPERS for the saved-art gallery of Studioodle, a welcoming all-ages coloring studio. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, actual transparent background. Entire paper stack visible with modest transparent breathing room. No text, labels, rings, binding, book spine, folder, solid blue cover, scenery, tools, or ground/cast shadow.

Style: refined storybook illustration, expressive fine hand-inked charcoal-blue outlines, warm ivory paper, delicate watercolor/gouache paper grain and gentle internal shading. It must match an illustrated honey-wood easel with curling ivory paper, teal paint and coral brush, and an open botanical coloring book in cream, muted teal, coral and soft gold. Dimensional but clearly illustrated, neither rigid geometric rectangles nor photorealistic 3D. Premium and inviting to adults and children.

Subject: a casual uneven pile of around 8 to 12 independent blank art sheets, mostly landscape, with a few square/portrait sheets peeking from underneath at slightly different rotations and offsets. Modest thickness and loose air gaps at curled corners; the individual sheets should feel supple with bowed edges, some corners lifting and other edges softly falling. Not a perfectly aligned stack; not a bound booklet; not a disorganized heap. A few tiny restrained watercolor teal/gold flecks near outer paper edges are fine, but all sheets are essentially BLANK.

COMPOSITING REQUIREMENT: the uppermost landscape sheet is viewed almost straight down, only a very shallow perspective, broad and near-rectangular with rounded natural paper edges. Its central 70% is clean uninterrupted warm ivory, relatively flat and parallel to the image plane, so a live drawing can later be overlaid there. Keep the beautiful curl, page bends, and hand-inked contours around the OUTER margins. The lower rotated sheets and layered edges must remain clearly visible around several sides, especially the lower edge and opposite corners. Give a subtly magical, tactile, creative feeling through graceful paper curves and beautiful ink strokes, without distracting decorative clutter.
assets.editPrompt: Edit this paper-stack asset ONLY to correct its background/alpha. Preserve the exact illustration, blank paper surfaces, warm ivory watercolor grain, hand-inked contours, curls, page shapes, rotations, proportions, flecks and composition. Remove ALL gray/brown background haze and the soft external cast shadow around/under the pile. Every pixel outside the actual paper silhouettes must be fully TRANSPARENT, except the normal narrow antialiased edge. No tinted translucent rectangle, no vignette, no glow, no ground shadow, no backdrop. The paper surfaces themselves should be opaque. Keep the subtle internal contact shading BETWEEN stacked sheets. Output this same standalone art stack on a genuinely transparent background; do not redesign the illustration or add anything.

assets.name: sheet-landscape
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE single blank loose art-paper sheet as a transparent UI compositing asset for Studioodle. Match the supplied paper-stack reference: fine expressive charcoal-blue hand-inked perimeter, warm ivory watercolor paper grain, subtly worn and faded edges, soft internal shading. This is a SINGLE SHEET ONLY, no other sheets, no stack, no props, no text, no markings, no shadow outside silhouette. Near orthographic overhead view, virtually rectangular face, natural softly bowed edges, small gentle lower-right corner curl showing its underside confined to the outer 7% of sheet. The central 85% must be uninterrupted flat blank pale ivory for compositing a live drawing; no folds crossing center. Paper face opaque, outside fully transparent. Sheet upright and level without rotation, fully visible filling about 94% of canvas with narrow even transparent margins. Restrained beautiful storybook aesthetic, not photorealism. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, do not recreate the pile. FORMAT: LANDSCAPE sheet, width to height exactly 4:3. Landscape output canvas matching that ratio.
assets.mask: The alpha silhouette clips the composition. The complete picture maps to calibrated curved face boundaries; a separate multiply layer preserves the original paper texture, ink border and folded underside. No cover crop, boundary-pixel extension or faded inset.
